scope: Fixed revisions only. Policy descriptions are reviewed source intent, not formal proofs or a paired-recall measurement.

policy.text: A token is marked valid only after parsing, allowed-method selection, key resolution, signature verification and enabled claim checks succeed. A signature failure returns before claim-error classification.
policy.boundary: Claims, key lookup and signature primitives are external to this method; their real semantics cannot be replaced by a permissive stub.

policy.text: A device grant must validate that the supplied device authorization is present, valid and bound to the requesting client before a token is issued.
policy.boundary: Device authorization depends on validator hooks and their callers. Reading this local method does not establish end-to-end device validation or fixed-version compliance.

policy.text: Activation revocation must use the claim's subject and issued-at time, not the wall clock at validation. Missing claim, subject or issued-at metadata fails closed.
policy.boundary: Credential expiry and the server's use of this library result are additional boundaries, not proven by this helper alone.

policy.text: An import's activation must match the exporting account, importing account, import type and allowed subject, and its activation claims must pass validation.
policy.boundary: Validation records errors in a caller-supplied accumulator; an application must reject accumulated errors. This method does not return a grant decision.

policy.text: With a scalar expected issuer, the claim must be present and equal to that entire string. With a collection of expected issuers, the claim must be a member. An absent expected issuer leaves this check disabled.
policy.boundary: The policy is conditional on a configured issuer; it must not be strengthened into an unconditional issuer requirement.

policy.text: Per-entity bucket placement should not force unrelated entities onto one hot storage partition. In BLOCK mode, storage unavailability must not silently become a granted lease.
policy.boundary: The selected acquire method shows lease and failure handling, not the entire storage-partition policy. Repository/schema and DynamoDB behavior are needed for the isolation claim. ALLOW mode intentionally differs.

policy.text: Converting a principal scope accepts only principal slots; converting a resource scope accepts only resource slots. A mismatched slot produces an error instead of silently changing its meaning.
policy.boundary: The relevant operations are TryFrom conversions over enums and recursive policy structures, not a scalar stateful struct method.

policy.text: The application-supplied expected nonce remains in the validation parameters; token-provided claims cannot disable the nonce check.
policy.boundary: Actual nonce enforcement is delegated to the selected claims class's validate method; preserving the parameter is necessary but not a complete proof.

policy.text: JWT bearer claims require a configured nonempty audience set and a mandatory audience claim matching that set; missing server audience configuration is rejected.
policy.boundary: The library's claims registry enforces values and essentiality. Its semantics must not be replaced by an unconditional success answer.

policy.text: Untrusted attribute access must not expose the user folder's mutable data mapping for deletion.
policy.boundary: The fix is the data__roles__ declaration, enforced by Zope attribute access. Calling _doDelUsers directly omits that authorization boundary and is not a valid policy test.

policy.text: Merging caller-supplied verification options must not mutate that caller-owned mapping; defaults are applied to a copy so later uses cannot inherit disabled checks.
policy.boundary: This is a caller-alias/frame property. A model that copies all inputs automatically cannot establish it.

policy.text: A selected signing algorithm must satisfy the caller's allow-list and, for a JWK, equal the algorithm bound to that key before verification is attempted.
policy.boundary: Cryptographic verification is an external primitive. This review concerns selection and binding, not a cryptographic proof.

policy.text: Guarded string formatting preserves guarded attribute access for string instances and subclasses, rejects the unsafe class access path, and chooses container assertions from the accessed object's type.
policy.boundary: The safe formatter and Zope security manager are part of the real enforcement path; ordinary getattr or an arbitrary success stub is not equivalent.

policy.text: OpenID authorization checks the allowed/normalized request scope for openid, not merely the raw requested scope, before proceeding.
policy.boundary: The superclass validates and normalizes scope; bypassing it would remove the policy's essential context.

policy.text: A required audience cannot be absent or have an unsupported representation; a supported present audience must match the expected audience.
policy.boundary: The helper's optional-audience mode is intentionally different; token decoding and caller handling are outside this method.

policy.text: setByPath must neither traverse nor assign the named prototype-control keys while writing ordinary object paths.
policy.boundary: This is an object-identity and mutation property, not a claim that every malformed path is rejected or that all object operations are safe.
